name: What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is a digital marketing strategy that utilizes AI to create, optimize, and distribute content. Unlike traditional SEO, which focuses on human-generated content for search engines, GEO leverages generative AI models to produce high-quality, relevant content at scale. This includes text, images, and other media, tailored to improve visibility across AI-driven platforms, search engines, and conversational interfaces. The goal is to enhance discoverability and engagement in an increasingly AI-centric digital landscape.
acceptedAnswer.description: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) uses AI to create, optimize, and distribute content for improved visibility across AI-driven platforms and search engines.
